blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. Halving the embedding dimension once is not statistically detectable above $m=16$; two successive halvings always are. Combining an 8x dimensionality reduction with int8 yields a 32x reduction in per-vector storage at 94.4% of baseline effectiveness. Because evaluation times were measured once, we treat them as indicative: we find no evidence that quantization speeds up evaluation, whereas sampling from intermediate layers shortens it substantially. Retrieval degrades far faster than every other category, so we report findings per task category.
blocks.zh: 分级文本嵌入模型提供了可变长的表示,而量化则降低了数值精度;两者都旨在提高计算效率. 这项工作是对这两种已确立的正统技术如何相互作用的经验性基准研究。 我们用四个基于变压器的嵌入模型来评价来自Massive Text Embedding Basic(MTEB)的38项任务,涵盖1D和2D的分级表示,结合32位,8位,和二进制量化,每个任务168个配置. 我们分别报告每个效率方面:理论/每个媒介存储和端到端评价时间。 根据与Nemenyi hoc后分析的Friedman测试,在统计学上,Int8的量化与对等分类和重排的flom32是无法区分的,其成本总体最高为1.5个百分点,而二进制的量化则在每一个任务类别中都严重恶化。 从统计学上看,将嵌入维度减半一次无法检测到高于16,000美元;连续两次将嵌入维度减半总是如此。 将8x维度减小与整数8相结合后,每个载体储存量将减少32x,达到基准效力的94.4%。 由于评估时间被测量过一次,我们把它们视为指示性的:我们没有发现量化能加速评估的证据,而中间层的取样则大大缩短了评估。 检索的降解速度远快于其他类别,因此我们报告每个任务类别的调查结果。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Learned representations, commonly called embeddings, represent diverse data types (e.g., words, documents) as real-valued vectors, organized such that semantically similar items are positioned close together within the embedding space [ 1 ] . Since Word2Vec [ 2 ] , embeddings have advanced further, notably with BERT [ 3 ] , which marked a shift towards context-dependent embeddings, and with Sentence-BERT [ 4 ] and SimCSE [ 5 ] , designed to learn embeddings for entire sentences. These representations then power a wide spectrum of downstream tasks, including classification, clustering, and retrieval [ 6 ] . Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) [ 7 ] stands as a prominent example: a typical RAG pipeline involves chunking and embedding documents, retrieving relevant chunks based on similarity to a user query, and then generating a response from a large language model.
blocks.zh: 所学的表示法,通称为嵌入法,代表了不同数据类型(如词,文档等)作为真实值的向量,其组织方式使得在嵌入法空间内类似物被紧密地定位在一起[1]. 自Word2Vec [2]起,嵌入已进一步推进,尤其是BERT [3],这标志着向上下文依赖嵌入的转变,并有Pried-BERT [4]和SimCSE [5],旨在为整个句子学习嵌入. 这些表述随后赋予了广泛的下游任务,包括分类、集群和检索[6]。 检索增强生成(RAG)[7]是一个突出的例子:一个典型的RAG管道涉及块并嵌入文档,根据用户查询的相似性检索相关的块,然后从一个大语言模型中生成一个响应.

blocks.en: The use of embeddings at scale has two primary costs: (1) inference, which involves computing embeddings for new data, and is typically a one-time cost per element, as embeddings can be stored; and (2) downstream tasks, which often involve repeated comparisons between embeddings loaded into memory. An RAG index of one million chunks encoded as 1024-dimensional float32 vectors already occupies about 4 GB. Matryoshka Representations (MRs) [ 8 , 9 ] offer hierarchical embedding storage, enabling the selection of representation size, and with 2D MRs also of the layer, during inference. Additionally, quantization techniques [ 10 , 11 ] aim to reduce the bit precision of embedding values, resulting in a smaller memory footprint.
blocks.zh: 规模嵌入法的使用有两种主要成本:(1)推论,涉及为新数据进行计算嵌入,由于嵌入法可以被存储,一般是每个元素的一次性成本;(2)下游任务,经常涉及嵌入法被装入内存之间的反复比较. 一个100万块的RAG指数编码为1024-维浮32向量已经占据了大约4GB. Matryoshka Presentations(MRs)[8,9]提供分级嵌入存储,可以选择表示大小,在推论时也有2D MR. 此外,量化技术[10,11]旨在降低嵌入值的比特精度,导致记忆足迹更小.

blocks.en: While these techniques have been investigated individually, their combined effect on embedding performance and efficiency remains an open question. This work seeks to address this gap, aiming to answer the following research question: RQ: “In the context of transformer-based text embedding models, can hierarchical representations and quantization be combined to improve the computational efficiency of embeddings while maintaining high performance on downstream tasks?” Our research is guided by four objectives: to evaluate the combined impact of hierarchical representations and quantization across a diverse set of tasks, identifying which task categories are most resilient to dimensionality reduction and precision loss; to quantify the efficiency gains in per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time; to determine configurations of dimensionality, numerical precision, and inference layer that balance performance preservation with resource efficiency; and to establish practical guidelines for resource-constrained environments.
blocks.zh: 虽然对这些技术进行了单独调查,但它们对嵌入性能和效率的综合影响仍然是一个有待解决的问题。 这项工作旨在弥补这一差距,目的是回答以下研究问题: RQ:“在以变压器为基础的文本嵌入模型中,能否将分级表示和量化结合起来,以提高嵌入的计算效率,同时保持下游任务的高性能?” 我们的研究以四个目标为指导:评价分级表述和量化对一系列不同任务的综合影响,确定哪些任务类别最能抵御减少维度和精准损失;量化每个载体存储和端到端评价时间的效率收益;确定维度、数字精准度和推论层的配置,以平衡业绩保存和资源效率;为资源紧张的环境制定切实可行的准则。

Table 1 traces a single query vector q q and two candidate vectors, one relevant ( d 1 d_{1} ), one not ( d 2 d_{2} ), through the two transformations studied in this paper. Truncating to the leading m = 128 m=128 dimensions and then mapping to int8 leaves the ranking of d 1 d_{1} above d 2 d_{2} intact while shrinking the index from 4.10 GB to 0.13 GB, a 32 × \times reduction in stored bytes. blocks.en: 1.2 Contributions and positioning
blocks.zh: 1.2 贡献和定位

blocks.en: We stress that this paper is an empirical benchmark and guideline study , not a proposal for a new model, training objective, or compression algorithm. Specifically: 1. A controlled factorial benchmark. We evaluate the full cross-product of hierarchical size, numerical precision, and (for 2D models) inference layer, with 168 configurations per task, over 38 MTEB tasks and four transformer-based embedding models. 2. Disaggregated efficiency accounting. We separate theoretical per-vector storage from measured end-to-end evaluation wall-clock time, and we show that the two do not move together. 3. Statistical validation. We subject the results to Friedman, Nemenyi, and Wilcoxon signed-rank testing, which shows, for example, that a single halving of the embedding dimension is not statistically detectable at any size above m = 16 m=16 , whereas two successive halvings always are. 4. Task-category-resolved guidelines. Because different MTEB categories react very differently to compression, we report and recommend per category, and we identify retrieval as the category that constrains aggressive optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们强调,本文是一份实证基准和准则研究,而不是关于新模型、培训目标或压缩算法的建议。 具体而言: 1. 控制系数基准。 我们评价等级大小,数值精度和(对于2D模型)推论层的全部跨产品,每个任务有168个配置,超过38个MTEB任务和4个基于变压器的嵌入模型. 2. 分类效率核算。 我们从测量的端到端评价时钟时间中分离出理论上的每个向量存储,我们显示两者不同时移动. 3. 统计验证。 我们通过Friedman、Nemenyi和Wilcoxon的签名排名测试得出结果,例如,测试表明,将嵌入维度的一分之一在统计学上无法在任何大于米=16米=16的大小上被检测出,而连续两次将维度减半总是如此。 4. 任务类别解决指南。 因为不同的MTEB分类对压缩的反应非常不同,所以我们逐个分类报告并推荐,我们把检索确定为限制积极优化的分类.

blocks.en: 2 Background and related work
blocks.zh: 2. 背景和相关工作

blocks.en: This section reviews the two lines of work our study combines, hierarchical text representations and embedding quantization. What has not previously been established is how they behave in combination : work on hierarchical representations varies dimensionality at full precision, while work on quantization varies precision at full dimensionality. Practitioners nonetheless apply both simultaneously, on the untested assumption that two orthogonal compression mechanisms compose without interacting. Whether that assumption holds is an empirical question that requires a factorial design to answer.
blocks.zh: 本节回顾我们的研究结合的两行工作、等级文字表述和嵌入式量化。 以前尚未确定的是它们如何结合行为:关于分级代表的工作完全精确地不同维度,而关于量化的工作则在完全维度上不同精度。 然而,从业者同时适用,其假设是两个正统压缩机制组成时没有相互作用。 这种假设是否是一个经验性问题,需要一个要素设计来回答。

blocks.en: 2.1 Hierarchical text representation
blocks.zh: 2.1 分级文本说明

blocks.en: Traditional embeddings do not allow for flexibility when it comes to the dimensionality of the representation: all the d d dimensions must be used in downstream tasks to avoid significant drops in performance [ 12 ] , which has led to various attempts to develop more flexible representations [ 13 ] . Principal Component Analysis (PCA) [ 14 , 15 ] projects high-dimensional embeddings onto a lower-dimensional subspace, aiming to preserve as much variance as possible. It is fast and straightforward, but it is inherently a linear transformation, which limits its ability to capture complex semantic structures, and the projection must be fitted and stored for each corpus. Jointly-optimized subnetworks [ 16 , 17 ] involve training multiple interconnected subnetworks within a larger framework, enabling the system to dynamically adjust the dimensionality of the embeddings. While these methods offer greater flexibility, training such subnetworks requires substantial computational resources.
blocks.zh: 传统嵌入在代表的维度方面不允许有灵活性:所有 d 维度必须被用在下游任务中来避免业绩大幅下降 [12],这导致了各种尝试来发展更灵活的代表 [13]. 主要组件分析(PCA) [14,15] 将高维嵌入到下维子空间中,旨在尽可能地保持差异. 它是快而直截了当的,但本质上是线性转变,限制了它捕捉复杂语义结构的能力,投影必须被安装并存储每个体. 联合优化的子网络[16,17]涉及在一个更大的框架内培训多个相互联系的子网络,使系统能够动态地调整嵌入的维度. 虽然这些方法具有更大的灵活性,但培训这类子网络需要大量的计算资源。

MRs simultaneously optimize multiple loss functions across the specified dimensions, which encourages the model to prioritize essential information in the leading dimensions. This method requires minimal modifications to existing training pipelines, imposes no additional cost during inference, and matches or outperforms independently trained low-dimensional representations [ 8 ] .

blocks.en: 2.2 Quantization strategies
blocks.zh: 2.2 量化战略

blocks.en: In deep learning, quantization applies to two distinct areas. Model parameter quantization focuses on reducing the precision of weights and activations, through post-training quantization or quantization-aware training, to decrease memory usage and improve computational speed [ 19 , 20 ] . In contrast, embedding quantization targets the floating-point vectors that encode semantic relationships between words or sentences, whose memory overhead dominates in large-scale applications involving billions of vectors.
blocks.zh: 在深入学习中,量化适用于两个不同的领域. 模型参数量化侧重于通过训练后量化或量化-意识训练来降低重量和活化的精度,以降低内存使用并改进计算速度[19,20]. 相形之下,嵌入量子化的目标是将词或句子之间的语义关系编码成浮点向量,其内存上浮在涉及数十亿向量的大规模应用中占主导地位.

blocks.en: The simplest approach involves floating-point downsampling to Float16 or BFloat16, which achieves a straightforward 2 × \times memory reduction, often with negligible accuracy loss [ 21 ] . Converting embeddings to int8 reduces memory usage by 4 × \times , and integer arithmetic is both faster and more power-efficient than floating-point operations [ 10 ] . The most aggressive approach involves binary (1-bit) quantization, which yields a 32 × \times memory reduction relative to float32; in practice, search over binary codes with Hamming distance can achieve approximately a 25 × \times speedup compared to float32 search on the CPU, but binary quantization inevitably loses semantic nuance [ 11 ] . Alternative approaches include vector quantization methods, where embeddings are represented as discrete codes drawn from a learned codebook. Product quantization (PQ) [ 22 ] exemplifies this paradigm by dividing the embedding space into lower-dimensional subspaces and quantizing each subspace independently; together with its optimized variant (OPQ) [ 23 ] , it is the standard compression method in approximate nearest neighbor search libraries such as Faiss [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 最简单的方法是将浮点下取样到Float16或BFloat16,这可以实现直截了当的2×\times内存减少,往往可以忽略不计的准确性损失[21]. 将嵌入式转换为int8会将内存用量减少4×\times,整数算术比起起浮点操作来既更快又更能用. [10]. 最有攻击性的方法涉及二进制(1-bit)分量化,相对于浮点32产生32×\times内存还原;在实际操作中,用汉明距离搜索二进制代码,与CPU上浮点32的搜索相比,可以实现约25×\tims速度,但二进制分量化必然会失去语义上的细微. [11]. 替代方法包括向量量化方法,其中嵌入法作为离散代码取自于所学的编码本. Product quantization (PQ) [22]通过将嵌入空间分入下维子空间,并独立地将每个子空间分出;连同其优化的变体(OPQ) [23],它是近似相邻搜索库如Fais [24]的标准压缩方法.

blocks.en: Since quantization and Matryoshka are orthogonal techniques, we can first shrink an embedding via Matryoshka, then apply integer or binary quantization, compounding the memory savings; Huerga-Pérez et al. [ 21 ] study such combinations for RAG storage. Table 2 summarizes the trade-offs of the main methods. The accuracy figures reported for them originate from different papers, corpora, and evaluation protocols, and therefore support qualitative positioning only; a controlled comparison of PQ, PCA, and float16 is outside the scope of this work (Section 7 ). What Table 2 does show is a structural distinction: PCA and PQ obtain their compression from a transformation that must first be fitted to a corpus and then stored and re-fitted under distributional drift, whereas hierarchical truncation is a property of how the model was trained and costs nothing at inference, so one stored vector serves every supported budget.

blocks.en: Our experiments use (signed) int8 and binary quantization alongside the default float32 embeddings; in our implementation the conversion is performed by the quantize_embeddings function of Sentence-Transformers. The conversion from floating-point to int8 is done using bucketing, which divides the range of each dimension, from its minimum to its maximum over the embeddings being quantized, into 256 equally sized buckets, with each bucket represented by a single int8 number; no separate calibration set is used. Conversion to binary numbers is done by setting the binary number to 1 if the floating-point number is positive and to 0 otherwise. The resulting bits are packed eight to a byte, so a binary embedding of size m m occupies m / 8 m/8 bytes, in agreement with Eq. 4 . The packed codes are passed to the MTEB evaluators, which process them as ordinary numeric vectors; the Hamming-distance search used by dedicated binary indexes was not part of our protocol (Section 7 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Dataset and task selection criteria
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集和任务选择标准

blocks.en: All tasks that are part of the MTEB subset used for the Hugging Face leaderboard were considered. Then, tasks that were too computationally expensive were excluded. Since seven model configurations (three 1D models and the 2D model with four layers) are evaluated for eight hierarchical sizes and three quantization techniques, resulting in a single task being repeated 168 times, we removed any task taking longer than 15 min on any model to complete in its default configuration. The resulting 38 tasks (Table S1 of the Supplementary Material) span scientific literature, news, social media, technical forums, and customer service: classification (Banking77, Emotion, TweetSentimentExtraction, AmazonCounterfactual, MassiveIntent, MassiveScenario, MTOPDomain, MTOPIntent); clustering (the P2P and S2S variants of ArXivHierarchical, Biorxiv, Medrxiv, and StackExchange, together with Reddit and TwentyNewsgroups); pair classification (SprintDuplicateQuestions, TwitterSemEval2015, TwitterURLCorpus); re-ranking (AskUbuntuDupQuestions, MindSmallReranking, StackOverflowDupQuestions); retrieval (ArguAna, CQADupstackWebmastersRetrieval, NFCorpus); STS (BIOSSES, SICK-R, STS12 to STS17, STS22, STSBenchmark); and summarization (SummEval). Clustering groups either titles (S2S) or titles with abstracts or full posts (P2P) of scientific papers, forum posts, and news. Classification ranges from intent detection with up to 77 classes (Banking77) to emotion detection with six classes and counterfactual detection in product reviews. Pair classification detects duplicate questions and paraphrases; re-ranking orders candidate questions from technical forums and candidate news articles; retrieval covers counter-argument retrieval, duplicate questions from a webmasters forum, and medical documents. SummEval contains 1600 summaries of news articles paired with human expert ratings across four dimensions (coherence, consistency, fluency, relevance). The evaluations are performed on the respective test sets of the tasks, following the MTEB leaderboard methodology. Due to GPU memory problems, the Nomic model could not be evaluated on MedrxivClusteringP2P.v2, STS22, CQADupstackWebmastersRetrieval, and NFCorpus.

blocks.en: This criterion is not neutral. Task runtime in MTEB is driven overwhelmingly by corpus size, so the large retrieval benchmarks, among them MSMARCO, Natural Questions, HotpotQA, DBPedia, FEVER, ClimateFEVER, QuoraRetrieval and TRECCOVID, are all excluded, and retrieval is represented by three of the smallest corpora. The global averages therefore under-weight the workload that embedding compression is most often deployed for. Moreover, as the number of candidate documents increases, the margin separating the correct document from its nearest distractors shrinks, so a given amount of compression noise is more likely to reverse a ranking. Our retrieval findings, already the most pessimistic of any category, should accordingly be read as a lower bound on the degradation at larger scales.
blocks.zh: 这一标准不是中立的。 MTEB中的任务运行时间主要由实体大小驱动,因此大型检索基准被排除在外,其中包括MSMARCO、自然问题、热点QA、DBPedia、FEVER、ClimateFEVER、Quora Retrieval和TRECCOVID, 检索由三个最小的公司组成。 因此,全球平均数对嵌入压缩工作的工作量估计不足,而压缩工作最常用于这项工作。 此外,随着候选文件数量的增加,将正确的文件与其最近的分心器相分离的比值会收缩,因此一定数量的压缩噪音更有可能逆转排位. 我们的检索结果已经是任何类别中最悲观的,因此应被理解为在更大的尺度上对退化的较低约束。

blocks.en: Every evaluation time comes from a single MTEB run per configuration on a shared Google Colab runtime, whose run-to-run variability we could neither control nor measure. We therefore treat timing figures as indicative and interpret only timing effects that are large and consistent across configurations and task categories: sampling from an intermediate layer shortens evaluation substantially, and we find no evidence that int8 quantization brings a meaningful speed-up.

blocks.en: Following the approach used in the MTEB leaderboard, we rely on the simple average of relative performance across all the selected tasks; this score is simple to understand, but the mean can give excessive weight to tasks with higher variance in their scores. Full results and tables are available in our GitHub repository 7 7 7 https://github.com/marcopoli/Matryoshka-Quantization/blob/main/Results_Annexes.pdf . For the float32 embeddings of MBAI-1D (Fig. 2 a), the reductions from 1024 down to 128 cost only 4.8% of the original performance; as the MRs become smaller, the relative loss in performance increases, reaching 11% at 64 dimensions. The int8 embeddings almost match the performance of the float32 ones, falling behind by only 6.6% at most. The binary embeddings perform worse at all hierarchical sizes, and at m = 1024 m=1024 the difference already exceeds 17%.
blocks.zh: 遵循MTEB领导板采用的方法,我们依靠所有所选任务的相对性能的简单平均值;这个分数是简单的来理解的,但是这个取法可以给分数有较大差异的任务以过度的分量. 我们的GitHub寄存处载有全部结果和表格。 对于MBAI-1D(图2 a)的浮出32嵌入,从1024降到128只花费了4.8%的原始性能;随着MRs变小,性能的相对损失会增加,在64维时达到11%. 内嵌8几乎与浮点32的性能相匹配,最多只落后了6.6%. 二进制嵌入在所有等级大小上表现更差,在m = 1024 m = 1024时,相差已经超过17%.

blocks.en: Table 4 (a) reveals significant task-specific variations that are masked by the averaging process. Retrieval exhibits catastrophic performance degradation, dropping to just 0.06 at 8d for both float32 and int8 and completely failing (0.00) for binary embeddings, whereas Pair Classification maintains 70–71% performance at 8d for float32/int8. Clustering shows excellent resilience with binary embeddings, maintaining 50% performance at 8d compared to 57% for float32 and int8. The int8 embeddings maintain performance very close to that of float32 across all tasks, with perfect parity at 1024d for Clustering, Pair Classification, and Retrieval. Nomic (Fig. 2 c) supports all the observations made so far, while Stella (Fig. 2 b) shows a slightly different behavior: the performance remains constant for all quantization techniques when reducing the output embedding size from 8192 to 1024, which suggests that the model effectively uses a dimensionality of 1024. blocks.en: With the caveat stated above, reducing the hierarchical size is associated with shorter evaluation times, most visibly for classification and clustering (up to 27%; Table 4 c), for which downstream classifiers and clustering algorithms operate directly on the embeddings. Int8 embeddings are only up to 3 percent faster than float32 embeddings on average (Fig. 2 g), and Nomic is the only model in which the int8 embeddings are not faster than the float32 ones for all hierarchical sizes (Fig. 2 i), so we find no evidence of a meaningful speed-up from int8. Binary embeddings were faster than float32 ones in our runs, by a margin that we report as indicative. Retrieval runs with int8 and binary embeddings took 0.89 times the baseline time at every dimension, but the reduction is identical for every embedding size and for both precisions, while the float32 retrieval runs show no dependence on embedding size, which more plausibly reflects a single-run measurement than an effect of quantization. blocks.en: Concluding RQ-1D-1 , both the reduction of embedding size and quantization lead to performance decreases whose magnitude varies by task category, and Retrieval is particularly vulnerable. Concluding RQ-1D-2 , reducing the hierarchical size is associated with shorter evaluation times for classification and clustering, whereas we find no evidence that int8 is faster than float32. Answering RQ-1D-3 , int8 embeddings present the best trade-off between performance and memory consumption, whereas binary representations offer an even greater reduction at the cost of a significant decrease in performance.
blocks.zh: 结束RQ-1D-1, 减少嵌入体积和量化导致性能下降, 其规模因任务类别而异, 检索特别脆弱。 结束的RQ-1D-2, 缩小分级大小与分类和集群的评价时间较短有关, 而我们没有发现任何证据表明int8的速度快于浮点32. 在回答RQ-1D-3时,内嵌8是性能和内存消耗之间的最佳取舍,而二进制表示则以性能显著下降为代价提供更大的减少。

blocks.en: When only considering the final layer, the performance of the MBAI-2D model is within a 1% margin of the MBAI-1D model for each combination of embedding size and quantization technique (Fig. 3 a). Table 4 (b) compares layers 24 and 12 at m = 1024 m=1024 . Retrieval shows by far the largest degradation, losing 39.8% for float32, 38.3% for int8 and 34.1% for binary, roughly three times the average loss of 13.8%. At the opposite extreme, Clustering loses only 4.9%, Summarization 9.9%, Re-ranking 11.0%, and Classification 17.1%. This ordering is consistent with the 1D results, where Retrieval was likewise the category least tolerant of compression; we discuss the reason in Section 6.1 . The int8 embeddings track float32 closely across all categories, and the two cases in which they marginally exceed the float32 baseline at layer 24 (Retrieval at 1.002 and Summarization at 1.008) are within the noise. Categories already heavily damaged by binarization at layer 24, such as Retrieval at 0.632, have comparatively less left to lose, so their Δ \Delta values understate how unusable those configurations are. The degradation is also not strictly monotonic in layer depth: layer 16 ranks significantly better than layer 20 (Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en: The evaluation time decreases approximately linearly as the chosen layer for inference moves closer to the input layer (Fig. 3 b), which is expected because the number of executed transformer blocks falls proportionally. The same decrease is observed for each task category, mirroring the findings of the 2D MRs paper [ 9 ] . The evaluation times for float32 and int8 embeddings are almost identical, binary embeddings take slightly less, and the hierarchical size has a much smaller effect than the layer.

blocks.en: Concluding RQ-2D-1 , the performance of the MBAI-2D model decreases as the layer used for inference moves closer to the input layer, with substantial task-specific variation, while the precision and size effects observed for 1D MRs hold at every layer. blocks.en: 5.3 Statistical significance analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 统计意义分析

blocks.en: Averages alone cannot establish whether an observed difference is a real effect or an artifact of which tasks happen to be in the benchmark. Following Demšar [ 30 ] , we use non-parametric tests, because relative performance is a bounded ratio whose distribution is neither normal nor homoscedastic across task categories, which also use different underlying metrics. For each of the three experimental factors, precision q q , hierarchical size m m , and inference layer l l , we apply a Friedman test [ 31 ] in which every combination of the remaining factors with the task category provides a matched block. Where the omnibus null hypothesis is rejected we apply the Nemenyi post-hoc test [ 32 ] , with critical difference CD = q α ​ k ⁡ ( k + 1 ) / 6 ​ N b \mathrm{CD}=q_{\alpha}\sqrt{k(k+1)/6N_{b}} , and pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank tests [ 33 ] with Holm correction [ 34 ] . All tests use α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 and the full MBAI-2D grid of 96 configurations, the only model for which all three factors vary. Because the blocks share task categories they are not fully independent, so we rely on the effect sizes and the critical-difference verdicts, not on the magnitude of p p . Table 5 summarizes the results; the pairwise Nemenyi comparison of the precisions is detailed in Table S3 of the Supplementary Material.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The results answer the research question positively, with qualifications. Hierarchical representations and quantization can be combined: 1D MRs with int8 embeddings from the last layer ( m = 128 m=128 ) reduce per-vector storage by an exact factor of 32 while retaining 94.4% of the effectiveness. For those prioritizing speed , however, only the 2D model offers a substantial lever, since we found no evidence that int8 is faster than float32. Moreover, the cost in effectiveness of any given setting varies strongly across task categories.
blocks.zh: 结果以资格回答研究问题。 分级表示和分级可以合并: 1D MR从上层嵌入了入式8 (m = 128 m = 128),将每个向量存储的精确系数降低32而保留了94.4%的效能. 然而,对于那些优先速度的人来说,只有2D型机型提供了巨大的杠杆,因为我们没有发现任何证据表明Int8比浮点32快。 此外,任何特定环境的效率成本因任务类别而大相径庭。

blocks.en: 6.1 Why some task categories are more sensitive than others
blocks.zh: 6.1 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 为什么有些任务类别比其他类别更敏感

blocks.en: A consistent finding across both the 1D and the 2D experiments is that retrieval degrades faster than any other category under both dimensionality reduction and quantization, while clustering and pair classification degrade the slowest. We identify four mechanisms, which act together.
blocks.zh: 在1D和2D实验中,一个一致的发现是,取回在维度还原和量子化下降解速度快于任何其他类别,而集群和成对分类则降解速度最慢. 我们确定了四个共同运作的机制。

blocks.en: Classification, clustering and pair classification only require that an item fall on the correct side of a decision boundary, which is stable under perturbations that are small relative to the margin, whereas retrieval requires the correct ordering of candidates: any perturbation large enough to reverse two adjacent similarity scores changes the result. Re-ranking, which orders a short candidate list, sits between the two extremes.
blocks.zh: 分类,集群和对等分类只要求一个物品落在一个决定边界的正确一面,在相对于比值较小的扰动下是稳定的,而取回则要求考生的正确顺序:任何扰动大小足以倒置相邻的两个相邻相似分数会改变结果. 重新排位,它命令一个短名单,坐在两个极端之间.

blocks.en: As the number of documents grows, the expected similarity gap between the correct document and its nearest distractors shrinks, so a fixed amount of quantization noise becomes progressively more likely to reverse an ordering. A retrieval query is compared with thousands of documents, whereas an STS instance compares a single pair.
blocks.zh: 随着文档数量的增加,正确的文档与其最近的分流器之间的预期相似性差距会收缩,因此固定数量的量化噪声会逐渐地更可能逆转订单. 检索查询与上千个文件进行比较,而STS实例则比较一对文件。

blocks.en: MTEB’s classification tasks train a logistic-regression probe on the compressed embeddings themselves , which can partially absorb a systematic distortion, and k k -means re-estimates its centroids in the compressed space. Retrieval has no trainable component: the similarity function is fixed, so any distortion propagates directly into the final score. This explains why classification is robust to dimension reduction, where the probe can compensate, but fragile under layer reduction ( − 17.1 % -17.1\% from L24 to L12), where the features the probe would need have not yet been computed.
blocks.zh: MTEB的分类任务在被压缩的嵌入物上训练出一个后勤后退探测器,可以部分地吸收系统扭曲,而k-意指在被压缩的空间中重新估计它的百分数. 检索没有可训练部件:相似性功能被固定,因此任何扭曲都直接传播到最终分数. 这解释了为什么分类对减小维度是强有力的,探测器可以补偿,但在降低地层(从L24到L12)下脆弱,而探测器所需的特性尚未计算。

blocks.en: Matryoshka training concentrates the dominant semantic directions in the leading coordinates, so the trailing coordinates carry the fine-grained distinctions needed to separate documents that are all topically relevant to a query. Truncation removes the tail first, and binary quantization also discards magnitude, which is why the two techniques interact so destructively for retrieval: at m = 8 m=8 with binary quantization, relative retrieval performance reaches 0.00.
blocks.zh: Matryoshka训练将主语义方向集中在了主坐标上,因此后导坐标带有了区分所有与查询主题相关的文件所需的细微区分. 分流首先去掉尾巴,而二进制分流也丢弃了分量,这就是为什么两种技术为了取回而有如此破坏性地相互作用: 在m = 8 m = 8 用二进制分流,相对取回性能达到0.

blocks.en: Taken together, these mechanisms imply that the ordering is a property of the task structure rather than of the particular models or datasets used here. We therefore expect it to generalize, and we recommend treating the presence of a large-candidate-set ranking stage, rather than the choice of embedding model, as the primary signal that conservative compression settings are required.
blocks.zh: 总之,这些机制意味着订单是任务结构的财产,而不是此处使用的特定模型或数据集的财产。 因此,我们期望它得到概括,我们建议将存在一个大型的candidate-set排名阶段,而不是选择嵌入模型,作为需要保守压缩设置的主要信号.

blocks.en: 6.2 Practical guidelines for resource-constrained deployments
blocks.zh: 6.2 资源受限制部署的实际准则

blocks.en: Storage ratios are exact (Eq. 4 ); effectiveness figures are relative to the m = 1024 m=1024 , float32, final-layer baseline, for which MBAI-1D and MBAI-2D differ by less than 1%, and timings are indicative. • High-effectiveness applications , such as enterprise search: use m = 1024 m=1024 or m = 512 m=512 with int8, which retain 99% and 98% of baseline effectiveness at 4 × \times and 8 × \times smaller per-vector storage. A single halving of the dimension is not a statistically detectable change, so moving from 1024 to 512 is close to free. The gain is capacity, not speed. • Balanced applications , such as general-purpose RAG pipelines: deploy m = 256 m=256 with int8, which retains 96% of baseline effectiveness at 16 × \times smaller storage with a tight spread across task categories (SD 0.032). This is our recommended default when the workload is not known in advance. • Resource-constrained environments , such as mobile applications: use m = 128 m=128 with int8, accepting 5.6% degradation for a 32 × \times storage reduction. This is safe for classification, clustering, STS and pair classification, but not for first-stage retrieval, which retains only 0.89 of baseline at this setting on our small corpora and would degrade further at scale. Binary quantization costs 17% of effectiveness even at full size and is significantly worse than float32 in every category; we recommend it only as the candidate-generation stage of a two-stage pipeline with Hamming-distance search and higher-precision rescoring [ 11 ] . • Speed-critical applications : only the 2D model offers a substantial lever. Sampling from layer 12 combined with m = 128 m=128 and int8 roughly halved evaluation time in our measurements, at an 18.1% cost in effectiveness, but the layer must be validated empirically rather than chosen by depth, since layer 16 ranked significantly better than layer 20, and the cost of layer reduction ranges from 4.9% for clustering to 39.8% for retrieval. The appropriate lever also depends on the task category. Retrieval is highly sensitive to aggressive optimization, so moderate configurations ( m ≥ 256 m\geq 256 with int8) are recommended; in RAG systems, however, the re-ranking component is markedly more resilient to layer reduction than first-stage retrieval (11.0% against 39.8% from layer 24 to layer 12 with float32), which makes 2D MRs a sensible optimization for the re-ranking stage. Clustering shows exceptional resilience to layer reduction, losing only 4.9% when moving from layer 24 to layer 12, which makes it the strongest candidate for aggressive speed optimization; it also retains reasonable performance under binary quantization (50% retention at 8 dimensions). Classification is highly tolerant of dimension reduction but less tolerant of layer reduction (17.1%), so the recommended lever is truncation. STS and pair classification show excellent resilience to dimension reduction, and pair classification is also comparatively robust to layer reduction (12.8%); since a single halving costs no measurable effectiveness, truncation is again the safer first step.

blocks.en: First, the storage reduction is real and the speed reduction largely is not : in our protocol the encoder forward pass dominates the cost, and the benchmark’s evaluators do not exploit integer arithmetic, so int8 should be adopted for capacity, not latency. Second, the speed-ups reported for binary retrieval [ 11 ] come from Hamming distance over the packed words, a regime our protocol does not exercise, so a deployment that uses such search should expect a better speed return than our figures suggest. Third, intermediate-layer inference is the only lever that reduces embedding generation cost , since it alone changes how many transformer blocks are executed; deployments that continuously index new documents will find it more valuable than the storage levers.

blocks.en: The binding constraint is that the vector index should fit in the RAM of a single commodity server; the uncompressed baseline requires about 20.5 GB. Because the workload is retrieval-dominated, our results forbid aggressive truncation, and m = 256 m=256 with int8 gives about 1.28 GB, a 16 × \times reduction, at 0.92 of baseline retrieval effectiveness and 0.96 averaged over all categories. If recall at the top of the ranking is critical, binary codes ( m = 1024 m=1024 , 0.64 GB) can be used for candidate generation, with the int8 vectors retained for rescoring of the shortlist.

blocks.en: The binding constraints are a fixed application memory budget and a strict latency target, and the workload is classification over a fixed label set, which tolerates dimension reduction well because its logistic probe re-fits around the compressed embeddings. With m = 128 m=128 and int8, each cached utterance embedding takes 128 bytes rather than 4 KB, at 0.94 of baseline effectiveness on average. Moving inference from layer 24 to layer 12 roughly halved evaluation time in our measurements, but classification loses 17.1% at layer 12, so the layer should be validated empirically.
blocks.zh: 约束性的限制是固定的应用程序内存预算和严格的耐久目标,工作量是在固定的标签集上进行分级,由于它的后勤探测器在被压缩的嵌入物周围重用,因此可以很好地容忍维度的减少. 以 m = 128 m = 128 and int8为单位,每个缓存的语句嵌入需要128个字节而不是4个KB,平均为基准有效性的0.94. 从第24层到第12层的推论 在我们的测量中 大约减少了一半的评价时间 但分类在第12层损失了17.1% 所以该层应该通过经验验证

blocks.en: 6.3 Performance comparison with state-of-the-art MTEB models
blocks.zh: 6.3 与最先进的MTEB模型的性能比较

blocks.en: Among embedding models up to 1B parameters on the MTEB leaderboard (27 July 2025), the models studied here ranked 20th (Stella), 29th (MBAI-1D), 43rd (Nomic), and 191st (MBAI-2D) (Table S5 in the Supplementary Material). The leading model, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, also supports Matryoshka Representations, as does the 8B-parameter Qwen3 model, which ranked first among embedding models under 10B parameters. Due to their later release, we were not able to conduct experiments on the newer models; however, we expect similar efficiency gains given their MR support.

blocks.en: We do not provide measurements for float16, PCA projection, Faiss scalar quantization, or product quantization under our own protocol, and Table 2 positions these families only qualitatively. We therefore claim only that Matryoshka truncation combined with int8 is effective, that it requires no fitted projection or trained codebook, and that it composes multiplicatively with precision reduction, not that it is superior to PQ or PCA at an equal compression ratio. A comparison against PQ at matched bit budgets is the single most valuable extension of this work.
blocks.zh: 我们没有为浮点16、五氯苯甲醚投影、Faiss scalar定量或产品定量提供测量数据,根据我们自己的规程,表2仅对这些家庭进行定性。 因此,我们只声称Matryoshka调取与int8相结合是有效的,不需要装配投影或训练有素的密码本,而且它与精度减取成倍,而不是在等压缩率上优于PQ或PCA。 在相应的位预算上与PQ进行比较是这项工作最有价值的一个延伸。

blocks.en: Every configuration was executed once, so the confidence intervals in Table 5 (e) quantify variability across task categories, not the stability of a repeated measurement. The effectiveness measurements are deterministic up to the seeded stochasticity of k k -means and of the logistic-regression solver, but the timing measurements were collected on Google Colab, a shared-tenancy environment that we could neither control nor observe. We therefore do not report any timing percentage as a headline result: the timing figures in this paper, including the 12% reduction measured for int8 embeddings at m = 128 m=128 and the reduction of roughly one half obtained by sampling from layer 12, are single measurements and should be read as indicative.

blocks.en: The runtime criterion removes all the large retrieval benchmarks, so our retrieval results are a lower bound on the degradation at larger scales (Section 4.2 ). MTEB itself is predominantly English and general-domain, so our findings may not transfer to multilingual deployments or to specialized domains.
blocks.zh: 运行时间标准取消了所有大型检索基准,因此我们的检索结果在更大尺度的退化上是较低的约束(第4.2节. MTEB本身主要是英语和普通领域,因此我们的结论可能不会转移到多语种部署或专门领域。

blocks.en: Binary quantization is significantly worse than float32 in every task category and only modestly faster in our setting, so we do not recommend it as a standalone representation. Our binary results should, moreover, be read as a lower bound on the technique: the packed codes were processed as ordinary numeric vectors rather than compared by Hamming distance, and at very small sizes the packing leaves the evaluators almost nothing to work with (at m = 8 m=8 a code is a single byte).
blocks.zh: 二进制量化在每一个任务类别中都比浮点三十二要严重地差,在我们的设定上也只略快一些,所以我们不建议它作为独立的代表. 此外,我们的二进制结果应被理解为技术上的一个下限:包装的编码是作为普通数字向量处理的,而不是用汉明距离来比较,在非常小的尺寸上,包装使评价者几乎无所作为(在m=8m=8时,一个编码是一个单一字节).

blocks.en: Only four models were evaluated, only one of which (MBAI-2D) supports 2D representations, so every conclusion about layer selection rests on a single model. Inference-layer selection adds a configuration dimension that must be validated empirically per task, which increases the tuning burden of deploying 2D representations, and evaluating the 2D model consumed more compute than the three 1D models combined. Results were obtained on NVIDIA T4 hardware, and quantization support varies considerably across accelerators, so the timing results in particular may not transfer to other processors.
blocks.zh: 只有4个模型被评价,其中只有一个模型(MBAI-2D)支持2D表示,因此每个关于层选择的结论都依赖于一个单一模型. 推论层选择增加了一个配置维度,每个任务必须按经验验证,这增加了部署2D表示的调试负担,评价所消耗的2D模型比三个1D模型加起来的计算要多. 在NVIDIA T4硬件上获得了结果,而各加速器的量化支持相差很大,因此时间结果尤其可能不会转移到其他处理器上.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: This paper reports an empirical benchmark of the interaction between hierarchical (Matryoshka) text representations and embedding quantization, covering 168 configurations per task across 38 MTEB tasks and four transformer-based embedding models. Its answer to the research question is that the two techniques can be combined to improve efficiency while largely preserving performance, provided that storage and speed are considered separately and that the compression level is chosen per task category. Our central quantitative result is that 8-bit quantization combined with an eightfold dimensionality reduction ( m = 128 m=128 ) retains 94.4% of baseline effectiveness while reducing per-vector storage by an exact factor of 32, and m = 256 m=256 with int8 retains 96% of effectiveness at a 16 × \times storage reduction, the setting we would recommend as a default. For 2D representations, layer 12 combined with int8 at m = 128 m=128 roughly halved end-to-end evaluation time in our measurements, at a cost of 18.1% in effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 本文件报告了分级(Matroshka)文本表述和嵌入量化之间相互作用的经验基准,涵盖38个MTEB任务中每个任务的168个配置和以变压器为基础的四个嵌入模型. 它对研究问题的回答是,这两种技术可以结合提高效率,同时基本上保持性能,只要存储和速度分别考虑,并且每个任务类别选择压缩级别. 我们的中心量化结果是,8位量化加8倍的维度减值(m = 128 m = 128)保留了基准有效性的94.4%,同时将每个载体的存储量精确地减少为32个系数;而2分之256 m = 256 与整分之8保留了在16×x\x时间的存储量减值时的96%,我们建议作为默认设置. 就2D表示法而言,第12层与平方公尺=128米=128的平方公尺相加,在我们的测量中,端到端的评价时间大约减半,其效率为18.1%。

blocks.en: Three findings qualify these headline numbers. First, storage gains and speed gains do not travel together : we found no evidence that int8 shortens end-to-end evaluation time, and the only lever in our study that reliably reduces computation is sampling from intermediate layers. Second, statistical testing separates the differences that matter from those that merely exist : int8 is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, while binary quantization is significantly worse in all seven task categories at a cost of roughly 28 points; no single halving of the embedding dimension is statistically detectable above m = 16 m=16 ; and effectiveness does not degrade monotonically with layer depth. Third, the global average is the wrong object to optimize : moving from layer 24 to layer 12 costs clustering 4.9% and retrieval 39.8%, and at m = 8 m=8 with binary quantization retrieval collapses to zero while clustering retains half its effectiveness. Retrieval-heavy systems should stay at m ≥ 256 m\geq 256 with int8; classification and clustering workloads can be compressed considerably further.
blocks.zh: 三项调查结果使这些标题编号具有资格。 首先,存储增益和速度增益并不同时进行:我们没有发现任何证据表明Int8缩短了端到端的评价时间,我们研究中唯一可靠地减少计算的方法就是从中间层取样. 第二,统计测试将重要的差异与仅仅存在的差异区分开来:在统计学上,Int8与对等分类和重排的浮标32是无法区分的,成本总体最高为1.5个百分点;而在所有七个任务类别中,二进制量化则严重恶化,成本约为28分;嵌入维度的一分之一在统计学上无法被检测出在m = 16 m= 16;有效性不会以地层深度单调地降解. 第三,全球平均值是优化的对象错误:从第24层到第12层的成本将4.9%的集成和回取39.8%,在m = 8 m = 8,二进制定量回取崩溃为零,而回取分组则保留了一半的效能. 检索重型系统应保持在256 m\\克256米并带有整数8;分类和集群工作量可以进一步压缩。

blocks.en: The natural continuation of this work is to rank hierarchical truncation against product quantization, PCA, and float16 storage at matched bit budgets on the identical 38-task protocol, together with repeated timing runs on dedicated hardware and an extension to full-scale retrieval corpora, to billion-parameter embedding models, and to adaptive schemes that select precision and dimensionality per query.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的自然延续是对产品量化(PAC)进行分级分级,在相同的38个任务协议上按照相匹配的比特预算进行活浮16存储,同时在专用硬件上反复进行计时并扩展至全比例取回的Corpora,再扩展至十亿参数嵌入模型,以及选择精度和每个查询的维度的适应方案.
